instruction: Configure VS Code to automatically create a backup copy of any file to a cloud storage service whenever it is edited, using only built-in settings without extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have native cloud backup integration. While VS Code has auto-save features, uploading to cloud storage requires extensions or external tools.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code does not have built-in cloud storage backup capabilities without extensions
Evaluator appropriately uses the 'infeasible' function, which is the correct semantic approach for impossible tasks
Complete coverage: Since the task requires built-in settings only but VS Code lacks this capability, marking as infeasible is the correct verification approach
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why the task cannot be completed
